units.source_text: "你还记得《哈姆莱特》一剧中雷欧提斯的父亲对儿子忠告了些什么吗？

en.t: Do you still remember what Laertes' father advised his son in the play Hamlet?

units.source_text: 他说：不要把钱借给别人，也不要向别人借钱。

en.t: He said: do not lend money to others, and do not borrow money from others either.

units.source_text: 钱借出去就没有了，并且还失去朋友。"

en.t: Once money is lent out, it is gone, and you lose a friend as well."
